title: Pokemon TCG Gholdengo Surging Sparks 131/191 Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Gholdengo 131/191 Sv08: Surging Sparks Reverse Holo Pokemon card is a rare and sought-after collectible card from the Pokémon TCG. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company, this Stage 1 Pokémon card has an HP of 130 and features a stunning Reverse Holo finish, making it a unique addition to any collector's deck. With its uncommon rarity and English language, this card is a valuable and desirable piece for fans of the Pokémon TCG seeking to enhance their collection.
